The upstream task may have completed

The wait timed out, but the provider may still have produced the result. Click “Retrieve again” to get it back without downloading it from the provider dashboard.

Provider request refused by outbound policy at apimart GET https://api.apimart.ai/v1/tasks/task_01M5HV: This generation **was never sent**: api.apimart.ai resolved to 198.18.0.7 (the RFC 2544 range local fake-IP proxies use for synthetic addresses), and Nomi could not confirm a proxy is running, so it stopped the request before it left your machine. Confirm your local proxy under Model Access > Network (that row reads "Local proxy detected"), then generate again.

Submitted, but the result could not be retrieved this time

This shot was already handed to the provider; what failed is Nomi checking the task, reading its result or downloading it this time (usually the local network or proxy dropped for a moment, or the provider’s status endpoint returned an error). Do not generate again — that makes a brand-new one. Use “Retrieve again”: Nomi only checks the task and downloads it once more. The technical details below give the exact reason.
